name: ghost-mcp-secure
description: Secure-by-default MCP server for Ghost CMS (remote: Streamable HTTP + OAuth 2.1). Deployed via the included Dockerfile.

GHOST_API_URL.description: Your Ghost site base URL, e.g. https://your-blog.example.com (no trailing slash).

GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Ghost Admin API key, format id:secret (Settings -> Integrations -> Add custom integration).

MCP_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Password shown on the OAuth login screen (the human gate). Choose something strong.

MCP_OAUTH_SECRET.description: HMAC secret used to sign OAuth codes/tokens. Auto-generated; leave as is.

GHOST_WRITE_ENABLED.description: Allow creating/updating posts, pages, tags and uploading images.

GHOST_ALLOW_PUBLISH.description: Allow setting content status to published/scheduled.

GHOST_ALLOW_DELETE.description: Allow delete tools (irreversible). Keep false for an internet-facing endpoint.

GHOST_ALLOW_SYSTEM.description: Allow settings/webhooks/users/themes tools (highest privilege). Keep false online.
